learn.hook: Three friends and twelve laddoos. How can everyone get the same? Let's share fairly!
points: Sharing fairly means everyone gets the same amount.
To share, give one to each person, again and again, until none are left.
12 laddoos shared by 3 friends: each friend gets 4.
Sometimes some are left over. Leftovers cannot be shared equally.
Check your sharing by multiplying: 3 friends × 4 laddoos = 12.

example.q: Kabir shares 15 marbles equally among 5 friends. How many marbles does each friend get?
steps: Give 1 marble to each friend again and again.

learn.reallife: Sharing a pack of biscuits with your cousins or dividing team players for a cricket match needs equal sharing.

games.title: Fair or not?
items: 8 apples shared by 2 children is 4 each.
4 + 4 = 8, and both get the same.
Fair sharing means the oldest child gets more.
Fair means everyone gets the same amount.
9 bananas can be shared equally by 2 children with none left over.
Each gets 4 and 1 banana is left over.
16 crayons shared by 4 children is 4 each.
If 3 friends get 5 sweets each, there were 15 sweets.

quiz.q: Riya shares 12 laddoos equally among 3 friends. How many laddoos does each friend get?
quiz.explain: 12 shared into 3 equal groups gives 4 in each group. Check: 3 × 4 = 12.
steps: Give one to each friend: 3 gone
quiz.mistake: Takes away 3 from 12 instead of sharing

quiz.q: Arjun shares 10 kites equally between his 2 cousins. How many kites does each cousin get?
quiz.explain: 10 shared by 2 gives 5 each. 5 + 5 = 10.
steps: Give 1 each again and again: 5 rounds.

quiz.q: 20 rotis are shared equally by 4 people. How many rotis does each person get?
quiz.explain: 20 shared into 4 equal groups gives 5 each. Check: 4 × 5 = 20.

quiz.q: Meena shares 7 toffees equally between 2 friends. How many toffees are left over?
quiz.explain: Each friend gets 3 toffees. 3 + 3 = 6, so 7 − 6 = 1 is left over.
quiz.mistake: Gives the number each friend gets, not the leftover

quiz.q: Which is a FAIR share of 6 bananas for 2 children?
quiz.explain: Fair means the same amount. 3 and 3 are equal, and 3 + 3 = 6.
steps: Fair means both get the same amount.
4 and 2, 5 and 1, 6 and 0 add to 6 but are not equal.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any split that adds up to 6 is fair

quiz.q: Kabir shares 18 pencils equally among 6 friends. How many pencils does each friend get?
quiz.explain: 18 shared into 6 equal groups gives 3 each. Check: 6 × 3 = 18.

quiz.q: 5 friends each got 4 samosas. How many samosas were shared?
Aisha shares 9 stickers equally among her 3 friends. How many stickers does each friend get?
quiz.explain: 9 shared into 3 equal groups gives 3 each. 3 + 3 + 3 = 9.
steps: Give 1 each again and again: 3 rounds.
quiz.mistake: Takes away 3 from 9 instead of sharing

teach.ask: Gappu and his 2 friends found 9 worms. Gappu wants to keep 5! What is a fair way to share them?
teach.praise: 3 worms each, the same for everyone. That is fair!
teach.nudge: If I take 5, will everyone get the same? How many should each friend get?

revise.summary: Sharing fairly means everyone gets the same amount. Give one to each, again and again, until none are left. Check by multiplying.
focus: Share things equally among friends.
Tell a fair share from an unfair one.
Check a share by multiplying.
traps: Don't take away the number of friends. Share.
A split that adds up is not fair unless it is equal.
Don't add when you should multiply to check.

learn.hook: Can you cut a roti so that you and your sister get exactly the same? That's a half!
points: When one whole is cut into 2 equal parts, each part is a half.
We write one half as 1/2.
The two parts must be the same size. Unequal parts are not halves.
2 halves make 1 whole.
Half of a group: half of 10 laddoos is 5, because 10 shared by 2 is 5.

example.q: Joseph cuts a roti into 2 equal pieces and eats one piece. What part of the roti did he eat?
steps: The roti is cut into 2 equal parts.
He ate 1 of the 2 equal parts.
1 out of 2 equal parts is one half.

learn.reallife: Half a glass of milk, half an hour of play and half a cricket field are all halves around us.

games.title: Halves or not?
items: A roti cut into 2 equal parts
A paper folded exactly in the middle
A chocolate broken into a big piece and a small piece
An apple cut into 3 equal parts
A square cut corner to corner into 2 equal triangles
A cake cut into 2 parts, one big and one small

quiz.q: A laddoo is cut into 2 equal parts. What is each part called?
quiz.explain: When a whole is cut into 2 equal parts, each part is one half.
steps: The laddoo is cut into 2 equal parts.
Each of 2 equal parts is one half.
A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up half (2 equal parts) and quarter (4 equal parts)

quiz.q: Which fraction means 'one half'?
quiz.explain: 1/2 means 1 out of 2 equal parts.
steps: One half means 1 out of 2 equal parts.
We write it with 1 on top and 2 below.
quiz.mistake: Writes the numbers the wrong way up

quiz.q: What is half of 12 bananas?
quiz.explain: Half means share into 2 equal groups. 12 shared by 2 is 6. 6 + 6 = 12.
quiz.mistake: Doubles the number instead of halving it

quiz.q: How many halves make 1 whole?
quiz.explain: A whole cut into halves has 2 equal parts. 2 halves make 1 whole.
steps: A whole cut into halves has 2 equal parts.
quiz.mistake: Thinks one half is already a whole

quiz.q: Arjun breaks a chocolate into a big piece and a small piece. Are the pieces halves?
options: No, the pieces are not equal
quiz.explain: Halves must be 2 EQUAL parts. A big piece and a small piece are not equal.
steps: A big piece and a small piece are not equal.
Answer: No, the pieces are not equal

quiz.q: Riya has 16 bangles. She gives half of them to her sister. How many bangles does she give?
quiz.explain: Half of 16 is 16 shared by 2. 8 + 8 = 16, so half is 8.
quiz.mistake: Finds a quarter instead of a half

quiz.q: Kabir and Harpreet share ₹20 equally. How much does each get?
quiz.explain: Sharing equally by 2 means each gets half. Half of ₹20 is ₹10. 10 + 10 = 20.
steps: Sharing ₹20 equally by 2 means half each.

quiz.q: Meena ate half of a pizza. Kabir ate the other half. How much pizza did they eat in all?
quiz.explain: Two halves make one whole. So they ate the whole pizza.
steps: Meena ate one half. Kabir ate the other half.
quiz.mistake: Thinks two halves make two wholes

teach.ask: Gappu cut his chapati into 2 pieces, one big and one tiny. He says each is a half. Is he right?
teach.praise: Halves must be the same size! I will cut it again, fairly this time.
teach.nudge: Are my two pieces the same size? What must be true for halves?

revise.summary: When a whole is cut into 2 equal parts, each part is a half, written 1/2. Two halves make one whole.
focus: Know when parts are halves.
Find half of a group.
Know that 2 halves make 1 whole.
traps: Unequal parts are not halves.
Don't double when asked for half.
Two halves make one whole, not two wholes.

learn.hook: Fold a paratha in two. Do the edges match perfectly? Then you have two halves!
points: To check two parts are equal, fold one part over the other. If they match exactly, they are halves.
A shape shows one half shaded only if the shaded part and the unshaded part are equal.
Draw a line through the middle to split a shape into two equal halves.
A rectangle or square paper can be folded in half in different ways: along the long middle, the short middle, or corner to corner (for a square).
If the parts do not match, they are not halves.

example.q: A square paper is folded corner to corner. Do the two triangles match?
steps: Fold one triangle over the other.
example.answer: Yes, each triangle is a half

learn.reallife: Cutting a sandwich or a chikki bar fairly between two friends needs equal halves.

games.title: Is it a half?
items: A roti folded so the edges match gives two halves.
Equal parts that match are halves.
A big piece and a small piece are two halves.
Halves must be equal.
A square can be folded in half corner to corner.
The two triangles match.
A rectangle can be folded in half only one way.
Along the long middle or the short middle.
Folding checks if two parts are equal.
Matching edges show equal parts.

games.title: Half shaded?
items: 1 of 2 equal parts shaded
2 of 4 equal parts shaded
3 of 6 equal parts shaded
1 of 3 equal parts shaded
1 of 4 equal parts shaded
Big part of 2 unequal parts

quiz.q: How can Asha check that the two parts of her chocolate are equal?
options: Fold or place one part over the other
quiz.explain: If one part covers the other exactly, they are equal.
steps: Answer: Fold or place one part over the other

quiz.q: A shape is cut into 2 equal parts and 1 is shaded. What part is shaded?
quiz.explain: 1 of 2 equal parts is one half.
steps: 1 out of 2 equal parts is one half.

quiz.q: A rectangle has 4 equal parts. 2 are shaded. Is half shaded?
options: Only if they are next to each other
quiz.explain: 2 of 4 equal parts is the same as half.
steps: The rectangle has 4 equal parts. 2 are shaded.
So 2 out of 4 is half, even if they are not next to each other.

quiz.q: Which line splits a circle into two halves?
options: A short line at the top
quiz.explain: A line through the centre makes two equal parts.
steps: A line near the edge or at the top makes unequal parts.
A line through the centre makes 2 equal parts.
Answer: A line through the centre

quiz.q: In how many ways can you fold a square in half?
quiz.explain: Across the middle (2 ways) and corner to corner (2 ways).

quiz.q: A rectangle (not a square) can be folded in half along its middles in how many ways?
quiz.explain: Long-way or short-way. Corner-to-corner folds do not match for a rectangle.

quiz.q: Ravi folds a paper and one part is bigger. What does this tell him?
quiz.explain: Halves must match exactly.
steps: Halves must match exactly when folded.
One part is bigger, so they do not match.
Answer: The parts are not halves
quiz.mistake: Thinks any two parts are halves

quiz.q: A shape is cut into 3 equal parts and 1 is shaded. Is half shaded?
quiz.explain: 1 of 3 is less than half.
steps: The shape has 3 equal parts. 1 is shaded.
Half would be 1 of 2 equal parts, which is bigger.
1 out of 3 is less than half.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any one part is half

teach.ask: Gappu cut a leaf into two parts. How can he tell if they are halves?
teach.praise: I folded one over the other and they match. Halves! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How can I check that both parts are the same size?

revise.summary: Fold one part over the other to check if two parts are equal. If they match exactly, they are halves.
focus: Check halves by folding.
Tell if half of a shape is shaded.
Draw a line to make two halves.
remember: Parts that match exactly are halves.
A square can be halved along the middle or corner to corner.
traps: Don't judge by a quick look. Fold to check.
Not every cut makes halves.
1 of 3 equal parts is less than half.

topics.title: More than half, less than half

learn.hook: Raju ate some of his roti. Is what is left more than half, half or less than half?
points: If the left-over part is smaller than the eaten part, it is less than half.
If both parts are equal, exactly half is left.
If the left-over part is bigger, more than half is left.
A shape can be halved in different ways: a square by a straight line or a corner-to-corner line. Each gives two halves.
If you see one half of a shape, draw the matching other half to complete the whole.

example.q: A glass was full. Now the water is below the middle line. Is it more or less than half full?

learn.reallife: Petrol gauges and water bottles show at a glance if you have more or less than half left.

games.title: How much is left?
items: 1 of 4 slices left
1 of 3 slices left
2 of 4 slices left
3 of 6 slices left
3 of 4 slices left
5 of 6 slices left

games.title: Halves in many ways
items: A square can be halved by a line corner to corner.
It makes two equal triangles.
There is only one way to cut a rectangle in half.
Long-way or short-way, both are halves.
To complete a whole from its half, draw the matching half.
The two halves together make the whole.
Two halves of different shapes can still be halves of the same square.
Triangles or rectangles, each is half.

quiz.q: A pizza had 4 equal slices. 3 are eaten. What is left?
quiz.explain: 1 of 4 slices is less than half.

quiz.q: A pizza had 6 equal slices. 2 are eaten. What is left?
quiz.explain: 4 of 6 slices are left, and 4 is more than 3 (half of 6).

quiz.q: A bottle had water up to the middle mark. How full is it?
quiz.explain: The middle mark shows half.
steps: Water is exactly up to the middle mark.

quiz.q: Which is NOT a way to halve a square?
options: A line from corner to opposite corner
quiz.explain: A line near a corner cuts off a small piece. The parts are not equal.
steps: Lines down, across or corner to corner make 2 equal parts.
A line near one corner cuts off a small piece. Not equal.
Answer: A line near one corner

quiz.q: Mira sees half of a heart shape drawn on a fold line. What should she draw?
quiz.explain: Drawing the matching half completes the whole heart.
steps: Mira sees one half of a heart on a fold line.
To complete the whole, draw the matching other half.

quiz.q: 8 equal pieces of a chikki bar. 5 are left. Is it more than half?
quiz.explain: Half of 8 is 4. 5 is more than 4.

quiz.q: Two halves of a whole roti are put together. What do they make?
quiz.explain: 2 halves make 1 whole.
steps: So two halves of the roti make the whole roti.

quiz.q: A cake is cut into 10 equal pieces. 5 are eaten. How much is left?
quiz.explain: 5 of 10 is half.
steps: The cake has 10 equal pieces. 5 are eaten.
Half of 10 is 5, so half is left.

teach.ask: Gappu ate part of his mango. How can he tell if more than half is left?
teach.praise: If the part left is bigger than the part eaten, more than half is left! Chirp!
teach.nudge: What should I compare the left-over part with?

revise.summary: We can tell if less than half, half or more than half is left by comparing the parts. A shape can be halved in different ways.
focus: Say if less than half, half or more than half is left.
Halve a shape in different ways.
Complete a whole from its half.
remember: Smaller left-over part: less than half.
traps: Look at the part that is left, not the part eaten.
Not every line halves a shape.
Draw the matching half, not a different shape.

learn.hook: Amit and Bala have 5 mangoes. Amit takes 3 and gives Bala 2. Is that fair?
points: A share is fair if everyone gets the same amount.
Equal NUMBERS are fair only if the things are the same size. 3 small and 3 big mangoes are not equal.
If something cannot be cut, like a toy car, take turns or swap with something of the same value.
Sharing a group of mangoes equally between two: give one to each again and again. 8 mangoes → 4 each.
If one is left over, cut it in half or save it for later to keep it fair.

example.q: Amit and Bala share 7 mangoes. What is a fair way?
steps: Give 1 each, again and again: 3 each, 1 left.
Cut the last mango in half.

learn.reallife: Brothers and sisters often take turns with one cycle or one TV remote to keep things fair.

games.title: Fair or not?
items: 4 laddoos each for 2 children from 8 is fair.
Both get the same.
5 for Amit and 3 for Bala from 8 is fair.
Amit gets more.
Taking turns with one toy is a fair way to share it.
Both get equal time.
3 big and 3 small samosas to two children, 3 each, is always fair.
If one gets all the big ones, it is not fair.
Cutting an extra mango in half keeps the share equal.
Each gets half.

quiz.q: Bala gets 6 grapes and Amit gets 4 from 10. Is it fair?
quiz.explain: A fair share is 5 each.
steps: 10 grapes shared fairly by 2 is 5 each.
6 is more than 4, so it is not fair.
quiz.mistake: Thinks using all the grapes makes it fair

quiz.q: 12 mangoes are shared equally between 2. How many each?
Amit and Bala have one cricket bat. What is a fair way to share it?
quiz.explain: A bat cannot be cut, so they share time by taking turns.
steps: To be fair, they share the time.

quiz.q: 9 mangoes shared fairly between 2. What happens to the extra one?
quiz.explain: Each gets 4 and a half.
quiz.mistake: Gives the extra to one person

quiz.q: Ria has 3 big laddoos and Tina has 3 tiny laddoos. Is it fair?
options: No, the laddoos are not the same size
quiz.explain: Equal numbers are fair only if the pieces are the same size.
steps: But Ria's are big and Tina's are tiny.
Equal numbers are fair only if the pieces are the same size.
Answer: No, the laddoos are not the same size

quiz.q: 16 mangoes are shared equally between 2 friends. How many does each get?
Bala has 7 marbles and Amit has 3. How many should Bala give Amit to make it fair?
quiz.explain: 10 marbles in all, 5 each. Bala gives 7 − 5 = 2.

quiz.q: Which sharing of 6 rotis between 2 is fair?
quiz.explain: Both get the same: 3 each.
steps: 4 and 2, 5 and 1, 6 and 0 are not equal.
quiz.mistake: Picks a share that adds to 6 but is unequal

teach.ask: Gappu's friend took 5 berries and gave Gappu 3. Is it fair, and how can they fix it?
teach.praise: 8 berries means 4 each. My friend should give me 1! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How many should each of us get?

revise.summary: A share is fair if everyone gets the same amount. Equal numbers are fair only if things are the same size. Some things are shared by taking turns.
focus: Decide if a share is fair.
Share a group equally between two.
Find a fair way for things that cannot be cut.
remember: 7 mangoes: 3 each and cut the last in half.
A bat or a toy car: take turns.
traps: Using all the things does not make it fair.
3 big and 3 tiny laddoos are not equal.
Don't give the extra one to one person.

learn.hook: 3 is half of 6, and 6 is double 3. Half and double are opposites!
points: Double means two times: double 4 is 8.
Half means one of two equal parts: half of 8 is 4.
They undo each other: double 5 is 10, and half of 10 is 5.
On a number line, the distance from a number to its double is the number itself: 6 to 12 is 6.
The distance from a number to its half is the half: 12 to 6 is 6.

example.q: Guess who I am: double me is 14.

learn.reallife: Recipes are doubled for guests and halved for a small family.

quiz.q: What is double 8?
What is half of 24?
Double a number is 30. What is the number?
quiz.explain: Half of 30 is 15. Check: 15 + 15 = 30.

quiz.q: Half of a number is 8. What is the number?
quiz.explain: Double 8 is 16.

quiz.q: On a number line, how far is 10 from its double?
How far is 16 from its half on a number line?
quiz.explain: Half of 16 is 8. 16 − 8 = 8.

quiz.q: Guess who I am: I am half of 40, and double 10.
Riya has 7 bangles. Meena has double. How many does Meena have?

teach.ask: Gappu knows double 6 is 12. What is half of 12 and why?
teach.praise: Half and double undo each other, so half of 12 is 6! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How are half and double related?

revise.summary: Double means two times and half means one of two equal parts. Doubling and halving undo each other.
focus: Find double and half of a number.
Find a number from its double or half.
Find distances to a double or half on a number line.
traps: Don't halve when asked to double.
If double a number is 30, the number is 15, not 60.
If half a number is 8, the number is 16, not 4.

learn.hook: Cut a watermelon into 4 equal slices and share with your family. Each slice is a quarter!
points: When one whole is cut into 4 equal parts, each part is a quarter. We write it as 1/4.
4 quarters make 1 whole. 2 quarters make a half.
3 out of 4 equal parts is three quarters, written 3/4.
A quarter of 8 laddoos is 2, because 8 shared by 4 is 2.
A quarter is smaller than a half of the same thing.

example.q: A watermelon is cut into 4 equal slices. Riya eats 1 slice and Arjun eats 2 slices. What part did they eat together?

learn.reallife: A quarter of an hour, a quarter of a cake and a quarter of a pizza are all around us.

games.title: Quarter quiz
items: A quarter of a roti is bigger than half of the same roti.
Cutting into 4 parts makes smaller pieces than cutting into 2.
2 quarters make a half.
2 out of 4 equal parts is the same as 1 out of 2.
4 quarters make one whole.
All 4 equal parts together make the whole.
A quarter of 12 is 3.
12 shared by 4 is 3.
Any 4 pieces of a roti are quarters.
The 4 pieces must be equal to be quarters.
Three quarters means 3 out of 4 equal parts.
That is what 3/4 means.

quiz.q: A roti is cut into 4 equal pieces. What is one piece called?
quiz.explain: 1 out of 4 equal parts is a quarter.
steps: The roti is cut into 4 equal pieces.
1 out of 4 equal parts is a quarter.

quiz.q: How many quarters make one whole?
quiz.explain: A whole cut into quarters has 4 equal parts. All 4 make the whole.
steps: A whole cut into quarters has 4 equal parts.

quiz.q: What is a quarter of 8 laddoos?
quiz.explain: A quarter means share into 4 equal groups. 8 shared by 4 is 2.
quiz.mistake: Finds half instead of a quarter

quiz.q: A cake is cut into 4 equal parts and 3 parts are eaten. What fraction of the cake is eaten?
quiz.explain: 3 out of 4 equal parts are eaten. That is three quarters, 3/4.
steps: The cake has 4 equal parts. 3 are eaten.
3 out of 4 equal parts = three quarters.
quiz.mistake: Writes the part that is left, or turns the fraction upside down

quiz.q: Which is bigger: half of a roti, or a quarter of the same roti?
quiz.explain: Cutting into 2 parts gives bigger pieces than cutting into 4. So a half is bigger.
steps: Half: cut into 2 parts. Quarter: cut into 4 parts.
Cutting into fewer parts gives bigger pieces.
So a half is bigger than a quarter.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 4 is bigger than 2, so a quarter must be bigger

quiz.q: How many quarters make a half?
quiz.explain: 2 quarters out of 4 is the same as 1 half out of 2.
steps: A half is half the whole: 2 of the 4 quarters.
quiz.mistake: Thinks it takes 4 quarters to make a half

quiz.q: Aisha has 20 marbles. She gives a quarter of them to Joseph. How many marbles does Joseph get?
quiz.explain: A quarter of 20 is 20 shared by 4. 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 20, so it is 5.
quiz.mistake: Finds half instead of a quarter

quiz.q: A pizza has 4 equal slices. Kabir eats 1 slice. What part of the pizza is left?
quiz.explain: 4 − 1 = 3 slices are left. 3 out of 4 equal slices is three quarters.
quiz.mistake: Names the part eaten instead of the part left

teach.ask: Gappu cut a mango into 4 equal pieces and gave one to his friend. What part did his friend get?
teach.praise: One out of four equal pieces is a quarter! Thank you!
teach.nudge: How many equal pieces were there? What do we call one of them?

revise.summary: When a whole is cut into 4 equal parts, each part is a quarter, 1/4. Three of the 4 parts is three quarters, 3/4.
focus: Name quarters and three quarters.
Find a quarter of a group.
Compare a half and a quarter.
traps: A quarter is smaller than a half, even though 4 is bigger than 2.
Don't find half when asked for a quarter.
Don't write 3/4 upside down.

learn.hook: Cut an orange into 4 equal pieces. Each piece is a quarter!
points: Objects showing quarters: a roti cut into 4 equal parts, a cake in 4 equal slices, a clock face split at 12, 3, 6 and 9.
To make quarters, draw two lines that cross through the middle. For a square, one across and one down.
All 4 parts must be equal to be quarters.
If you see one quarter, add 3 more equal parts to make the whole.
2 quarters make a half; 4 quarters make a whole.

example.q: You see 1 quarter of a square. How many more quarters complete the whole?

learn.reallife: A clock face is split into 4 quarters of 15 minutes each.

games.title: Quarter facts
items: A roti cut into 4 equal parts shows quarters.
Each part is a quarter.
4 unequal parts are quarters.
Quarters must be equal.
Two lines through the middle of a square can make 4 quarters.
One across, one down.
2 quarters make a whole.
4 quarters make a whole; 2 make a half.

quiz.q: Which shows quarters?
options: A cake cut into 2 equal slices
A cake cut into 4 equal slices
A cake cut into 4 unequal slices
quiz.explain: 4 equal parts are quarters.
steps: 2 slices are halves. 4 unequal slices are not quarters.
Answer: A cake cut into 4 equal slices
quiz.mistake: Forgets the parts must be equal

quiz.q: How many lines do you draw through the middle of a square to make 4 quarters?
quiz.explain: One line across and one line down.
steps: One line across the middle makes 2 parts.
One more line down the middle makes 4 parts.

quiz.q: Sonu has 1 quarter of a chapati. How many more quarters make a whole?
Mira has 2 quarters of a pizza. How much more makes a whole?
quiz.explain: 4 − 2 = 2 quarters.
steps: A whole = 4 quarters. Mira has 2 quarters.

quiz.q: A clock face is split at 12, 3, 6 and 9. How many equal parts?
quiz.explain: Lines from 12 to 6 and 3 to 9 make 4 quarters.
steps: Lines from 12 to 6 and from 3 to 9 cross in the middle.
quiz.mistake: Counts the numbers on the clock

quiz.q: Which is NOT a quarter of a square?
quiz.explain: One of 3 equal parts is a third, not a quarter.
steps: A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts.

One of 3 equal parts is a third, not a quarter.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any small part is a quarter

quiz.q: How many quarters make 1 and a half wholes?
quiz.explain: 1 whole = 4 quarters. A half = 2 quarters. 4 + 2 = 6.

quiz.q: An orange is cut into 4 equal parts. Riya eats 1 part. What part did she eat?
quiz.explain: 1 of 4 equal parts is one quarter.
steps: The orange has 4 equal parts. Riya eats 1.
1 out of 4 equal parts is one quarter.

teach.ask: Gappu wants to cut a square biscuit into quarters. How should he do it?
teach.praise: One line across and one line down the middle: 4 equal quarters! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How many lines, and where should they go?

revise.summary: Quarters are 4 equal parts, like a roti in 4 pieces or a clock face split at 12, 3, 6 and 9. Two lines through the middle make quarters.
focus: Spot quarters around us.
Make quarters with two lines.
Complete a whole from quarters.
remember: Two lines through the middle make 4 quarters.
1 quarter seen: 3 more make the whole.
traps: All 4 parts must be equal.
One of 3 equal parts is not a quarter.
Don't count the numbers on a clock as parts.

topics.title: Half or quarter of a group

learn.hook: 16 marbles: half are red and a quarter are blue. How many of each?
points: Half of a group: share it into 2 equal parts. Half of 16 is 8.
Quarter of a group: share it into 4 equal parts. A quarter of 16 is 4.
Half is double a quarter: 8 is double 4.
To tell if half or a quarter is coloured, split the group into equal parts and see how many parts are coloured.

quiz.q: What is half of 16?
steps: Half of a group: share into 2 equal parts.

quiz.q: What is a quarter of 16?
steps: A quarter of a group: share into 4 equal parts.

quiz.q: 8 of 16 beads are coloured. What part is coloured?
quiz.explain: 8 is half of 16.

quiz.q: 3 of 12 flowers are yellow. What part is yellow?
quiz.explain: 12 ÷ 4 = 3, so 3 is a quarter.
steps: 3 flowers are yellow, so it is a quarter.

quiz.q: A quarter of a group is 5. What is half of the same group?
quiz.explain: Half is double a quarter: 5 + 5 = 10.
quiz.mistake: Thinks half and quarter are equal

quiz.q: How many more is half of 20 than a quarter of 20?
quiz.explain: Half is 10, quarter is 5. 10 − 5 = 5.

quiz.q: Which is bigger: half of 8 laddoos or a quarter of 8 laddoos?
quiz.explain: Half of 8 is 4; a quarter is 2.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 4 parts is bigger than 2 parts

steps: A quarter of 24: share into 4 equal parts.

revise.summary: Half of a group means sharing it into 2 equal parts. A quarter means sharing it into 4 equal parts. Half is double a quarter.
focus: Find half and a quarter of a group.
Tell if half or a quarter is coloured.
Compare half and a quarter of a group.
traps: Don't find half when asked for a quarter.
Half and a quarter are not equal.

learn.hook: Colour 3 out of 4 equal parts. You have coloured three quarters!
points: Colour shapes to show a half (2 of 4 parts), a quarter (1 of 4) or three quarters (3 of 4).
On a grid of 8 squares, a quarter is 2 squares, a half is 4 squares and three quarters is 6 squares.
The coloured squares do not need to be next to each other. Any 2 of 8 is still a quarter.
Fraction puzzle: a half + a quarter + a quarter make one whole.
3 quarters + 1 quarter = 1 whole.

quiz.q: A square is cut into 4 equal parts and 3 are coloured. What part is coloured?
quiz.explain: 3 of 4 equal parts is three quarters.
steps: The square has 4 equal parts. 3 are coloured.
3 out of 4 equal parts is three quarters.

quiz.q: On a grid of 8 squares, how many squares show a quarter?
On a grid of 8 squares, how many squares show three quarters?
quiz.explain: A quarter is 2, so three quarters is 2 + 2 + 2 = 6.

quiz.q: Three quarters + one quarter = ?
quiz.explain: 3 + 1 = 4 quarters = 1 whole.

quiz.q: A half + a quarter = ?
quiz.explain: A half is 2 quarters. 2 + 1 = 3 quarters.

quiz.q: Two quarters show the same amount as…
quiz.explain: 2 of 4 equal parts = half.
steps: 2 of 4 is the same as half.
quiz.mistake: Thinks two quarters make a whole

quiz.q: A grid has 4 squares in a row. Raju colours the first and the last square. What part is coloured?
quiz.explain: 2 of 4 squares are coloured, which is half, even if they are not next to each other.
steps: The row has 4 squares. 2 are coloured.
The squares do not need to be next to each other.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the parts must be side by side

quiz.q: A puzzle has a half piece and one quarter piece. What piece completes the whole?
quiz.explain: Half + quarter = 3 quarters. 1 more quarter makes 4 quarters.
steps: A half = 2 quarters. Add one quarter: 3 quarters.
